name: SGGX Microflake Distribution
definition: A microflake normal distribution introduced by Heitz et al. [HDCD15] that supports fast and exact evaluation of attenuation coefficients, as well as efficient evaluation and sampling of specular phase functions.
summary: The SGGX Microflake Distribution is a normal distribution function for modeling anisotropic microflakes, distinguished by representing complex orientations with a single lobe for exact, fast optical evaluation.
